headline: Russian Geran-3 drone hits Nova Vodolaha park
dek: Russian Geran-3 drone struck the central park of Nova Vodolaha mid-afternoon while families were there: 6 killed including 3 children (updated breakdown: 3 women aged 28/34/36, girls aged 11 and 14 months; governor later revised some counts), 15 injured incl 7 children; cafe damaged; burnt-out…
sources: Reuters/Ukrinform/UATV (Kharkiv Regional Military Administration, Interior Ministry)
fault_line: With Ukraine and the US publicly splitting — who protects civilians now?

sections.what_happened: Russian Geran-3 drone struck the central park of Nova Vodolaha mid-afternoon while families were there: 6 killed including 3 children (updated breakdown: 3 women aged 28/34/36, girls aged 11 and 14 months; governor later revised some counts), 15 injured incl 7 children; cafe damaged; burnt-out stroller photos released by police. Zelensky called it 'pure atrocity'. UN HR monitors: 328 civilians killed and 2,105 injured in Ukraine in September (+85% vs last year); Kyiv had casualties 22 of 30 days.
sections.what_verified: Multiple outlets (Reuters, Ukrinform, UATV, Economic Times, NDTV, Times Now) with official photos; UN monthly civilian-casualty figures independently corroborate the trend. Minor toll discrepancy (governor initially 6/3 children, some outlets 6/2 children) — verified facts limited to Reuters' reporting.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian statement seen; Moscow routinely denies deliberate civilian targeting. NDTV relay: Russian-installed Luhansk official claimed a Ukrainian strike hit a funeral vehicle, killing 3 — uncorroborated counter-claim.
sections.why_matters: Connect: the Nova Vodolaha toll sits inside the UN's +85% September civilian-casualty spike and Zelensky's 'no warning / delayed US deliveries' complaints — the human cost of the US-Ukraine rupture.
sections.context: Background: Kharkiv: Russian Geran-3 drone hits Nova Vodolaha park — 6 killed incl 3 children, 15 hurt; UN: Sept civilian toll +85%
